references.text: Prohibition against going up to the altar by steps so as not to expose oneself, showing God's concern for decency in worship.
Fulfillment of the command to make linen undergarments for the priests.
The priest shall wear linen undergarments when performing service at the altar.
Aaron shall wear linen undergarments when he enters the sanctuary on the Day of Atonement.
Ezekiel's vision of the future temple includes linen undergarments for the priests to avoid sweat and ensure purity.
The verse provides the overall context for the production of the holy garments, which include linen undergarments.
Creates a theological contrast: nakedness is a sign of judgment, while linen undergarments are the condition for standing in God's presence.
Fig leaves as humanity's own solution to nakedness stand in contrast to God's commanded linen undergarments for holy service.
Specifies the use of linen undergarments in daily priestly service at the altar, as foreseen in Exodus 28.
